name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new feature or enhancement.
title: "[FEATURE] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Problem / motivation

What problem are you trying to solve? Why is the current behaviour
insufficient?

## Proposed solution

What would you like to see implemented? A rough sketch of the API,
config option, CLI flag, or workflow change is enough.

## Alternatives considered

Any other approaches you have thought about, and why they were rejected.

## Additional context

Links to relevant papers, upstream issues, or example inputs/outputs.
